branches.title: Branches
branches.description: Each branch keeps its own hours. Disabling a branch keeps its history and blocks new work there.
branches.emptyBody: Add the first branch for this barbershop.
branches.name: Name
branches.codeHint: A short unique code, such as CAI.
branches.enableBody: This branch can accept new work again. Past records stay as they are.
branches.disableBody: New work stops at this branch. Employees and history stay on record.
branches.formDescription: Name, contact details, and the hours this location is open.
branches.disabledNotice: This branch is not accepting new operations. Existing records remain.

employees.title: Employees
employees.description: An employee can work without a login, and a login can exist without an employee.
employees.name: Full name
employees.numberHint: Leave blank to assign the next number.
employees.branchesHint: A person can work in more than one branch. One branch is primary.
employees.emptyBody: Add the first employee when you are ready.
employees.formDescription: Personal details, employment, branches, and salary configuration.
employees.nationalIdHint: Stored privately. Lists show only the last digits.
employees.noBranches: Add a branch before assigning people.
employees.salaryHint: This stores the salary setup. Payroll is calculated later.
employees.formula: Gross is basic salary, allowances, commission, and tips. Net is gross minus deductions.
employees.statusBody: The employee record and its history stay in place.
employees.removeBody: The assignment is closed. Past attendance and sales stay attached.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.description: Roles belong to this barbershop. Choose permissions from the catalog.
roles.name: Name
roles.emptyBody: The starter roles appear after the owner signs in.
roles.enableBody: People with this role receive its permissions again.
roles.disableBody: People keep the role record, but it no longer grants access.
roles.formDescription: A role is a set of permissions. Branch access is chosen when the role is assigned to a person.
roles.matrixHint: You can grant only permissions you already have.

users.title: Users
users.description: Login accounts for this barbershop. Link an employee only when the person needs both.
users.name: Full name
users.employeeHint: Leave this empty when the person is an owner or does not have an employee record.
users.emptyBody: The owner account is created with the barbershop.
users.formDescription: Account details, an optional employee link, and the branches each role can reach.
users.accessHint: A person only reaches the branches selected for each role.
users.ownerScope: The owner can reach every branch.
users.pickBranch: Choose at least one branch for each selected role.

workforce.title: Workforce settings
workforce.description: Employment types, job titles, and commission rules for this barbershop.
workforce.name: Name
workforce.priority: An employee and service override is used first, then the service rule, then this default.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.description: Book a customer with a barber at one branch. Service prices are kept as they were at booking time.
appointments.formDescription: Choose the branch, customer, services, and barber. The customer does not pick the barber.
appointments.emptyBody: Create a booking or add a walk-in from the queue.
appointments.closed: This appointment can no longer be edited.
appointments.invalidWhen: Choose a valid date and time.
appointments.serviceRequired: Choose a branch, a barber, and at least one service.
appointments.snapshotHint: Prices stay as they were when the service was added.

queue.title: Queue
queue.description: Each branch has its own queue. New arrivals wait in the order they joined.
queue.walkInDescription: Find or create the customer, assign a barber, and place them in today's queue.
queue.customerRequired: Choose a customer or enter a new name.
queue.branchRequired: Choose a branch before opening the queue.
queue.reorderFailed: The queue changed. It has been refreshed.

services.title: Services
services.description: Services are shared by every branch of this barbershop.
services.emptyBody: Add a category, then add the first service.
services.formDescription: The price and commission apply in every branch.
services.capHint: Percentage commission on a service cannot go above this limit.
services.deactivateBody: The service stays on record and can be activated again.
services.activateBody: The service becomes available for new packages.

categories.title: Service categories
categories.description: Group services so the catalog stays easy to browse.
categories.emptyBody: Add a category before creating services.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Customers belong to the barbershop and can visit any branch.
customers.emptyBody: Add a customer when they visit for the first time.
customers.formDescription: Phone numbers are matched after removing spaces and country codes.
customers.name: Full name
customers.uniquePhoneHint: Turn this off only when the same number may belong to more than one customer.
customers.deactivateBody: The customer record and history stay in place.
customers.activateBody: The customer can receive new packages again.
customers.noVisitsBody: Visits appear here after appointments are recorded.
customers.noServicesBody: Completed services appear here after visits are recorded.
customers.noPaymentsBody: Payments appear here after a sale is recorded.
customers.noPackagesBody: Assigned packages appear here with the remaining quantity.

packages.title: Packages
packages.description: A package template can be sold to a customer. Earlier purchases keep their own price and quantities.
packages.emptyBody: Create a package from the services in this catalog.
packages.formDescription: Service names and prices are copied onto the package.
packages.deactivateBody: Purchased packages stay available until they expire or run out.
packages.activateBody: The package can be assigned to customers again.
packages.assignHint: Search for a customer, then assign this package.

finance.noPackages: This customer has no active package.

finance.refundsEmptyBody: A refund request appears here after it is submitted.

finance.commissionsEmptyBody: Commission appears after a paid checkout.

reportCenter.noAccess: You do not have a report permission.

note.appointments_are_not_sales: Completed appointments are not counted as sales.
note.net_includes_refunds: Net sales subtract processed refunds from the charged amount.
note.tips_are_separate: Tips stay separate from commission and net sales.
note.payment_net_is_amount_minus_refund: Payment totals are recorded amounts minus refunds on that method.
note.commission_from_snapshots: Commission uses the snapshot stored on the transaction.
note.completed_appointments_are_not_sales: Completed appointments are listed separately from paid sales.
note.payroll_amounts_hidden: Salary amounts are hidden without payroll view permission.
note.spending_uses_transactions: Customer spending uses paid transactions, not appointments alone.
note.new_customers_are_first_paid_sale: A new customer is someone whose first paid sale is in this period.
note.package_price_is_not_added_to_net_sales: Package prices are usage statistics and are not added again to net sales.
note.valuation_uses_branch_average_cost: Inventory value uses each branch average cost.
note.valuation_is_current: Valuation is the current stock value, not a historical snapshot.
note.supplier_payments_are_not_pos_sales: Supplier payments are not customer sales.
note.attendance_is_not_payroll: Attendance counts are not salary figures.
note.leave_remaining_uses_stored_balance: Remaining leave uses the stored balance.
note.payroll_status_is_explicit: Draft, review, approved, and paid payroll stay separate.
note.paid_rows_are_finalized_records: Paid rows come from finalized payroll records.
note.expected_cash_is_opening_plus_cash_sales: Expected cash is opening cash plus cash sales plus cash tips minus cash refunds.
note.supplier_payments_are_separate: Supplier payments are not included in expected cash.
note.supplier_payments_are_not_in_expected_ca: Supplier payments are not included in expected cash.
